title.zh: Ramp完成18.5亿美元融资，估值600亿美元：曾一周烧掉150万美元Token，如今要管企业AI账单
title.en: Ramp完成18.5亿美元融资，估值600亿美元：曾一周烧掉150万美元Token，如今要管企业AI账单

current_state.zh: Fintech company Ramp raised $1.85B at a $60B valuation led by Dragoneer with Thrive Capital and Founders Fund, on the back of >$2B annualized revenue and an expanding product line for tracking and routing enterprise AI token spending (AI Token Spend Management, Router claiming ~40% inference cost savings, and the Glass AI work platform).
